verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance's registered-agent page says service of process gets its own handling: legal documents are delivered electronically and the customer is notified by phone when service is received. However, nothing documents how ordinary mail is handled, so there is no stated separation between the two. There are also no explicit delivery commitments such as forwarding timelines or SLAs. Missing for 10: documentation contrasting service-of-process handling with ordinary mail handling, stated delivery-time commitments for each category, detailed process documentation, independent corroboration.
